title: The Locked Cellar
text: A librarian with ink-stained fingers offers to show you the books in the locked cellar, if you do not tell the dean.

pass.text: One book is a grammar of a language that is not for human mouths. You learn one sentence.

fail.text: The books are bound in something that still feels warm.

title: The Old Professor
text: A retired professor of ancient languages invites you to tea. He has been waiting for someone to ask.

pass.text: You talk until dawn. You leave knowing more than you did.

fail.text: He falls asleep in his chair halfway through his first story.

title: The House on the Hill
text: An old house that no family keeps for long. The cellar floor is soft, and it smells of mold.

pass.text: You dig, and find the journals of the first owner.

fail.text: Something under the floor knows your name now.

title: A Sculptor's Nightmare
text: A young sculptor shows you a clay figure he made in his sleep. He has made eleven more since.

pass.text: You recognize the symbols carved on its base.

fail.text: That night you dream of the same figure.
